item.title: Multiple Regression
item.description: (or “Why Knowing the Business Beats Knowing Regression”) Last week, we used a linear regression model to accurately convert temperatures from Celsius to Fahrenheit. But what happens when you have to estimate something a bit more complex? “This house is 2338 sq. ft…so, how much should it cost?” Obviously, we’ll need to account for more than 1 factor to model this. Luckily, we can do just this, using Multiple Regression!
